chapter: Jack Laine and the New Orleans scene
title: Jack Laine as a drummer and the Reliance band
summary: Laine was a steady but unremarkable drummer; better drummers like Diddy Stevens, and the Reliance band's parade crowds.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Jack style. I never let him play, uh, uh, drum. Do you remember it at all? Oh, Jack Lane? Yeah. Well, you mean orchestra, huh? No, I mean band work, either for dance or for, uh, marching.

Marching? Marching, yeah. Well, uh, he, he's, uh, he played, uh, steady, uh, nothing, uh, sensational. Didn't drag? No, nothing sensational. No. He, he played a good rhythmic, uh, bass drum and a, uh,
real steady beat. I have pictures of him in two different parades. One of them, he's playing the

bass drum. Yeah. The other one, he's playing the snare. Yeah, well, it was his choice, yes, either one. Oh, you see, Jack, Jack was never considered a good Dixieland drummer. When you, when you start figuring out, uh, fellas like Pete Mazzarina, and Rag Baby Stevens, and Diddy Stevens, and, uh, Paul Detroit, Johnny Stein, guys of that type that really, well, I remember the time when Diddy Stevens, you see, they had ten men for a carnival parade band, and, uh, Diddy Stevens would make those niggers dance just by playing the march. Didn't need the band. He did. Oh, did you know at that time that the, there was a fellow with a billiard cue used to beat those niggers back? No. Oh, sure, that was, uh, oh, they'd kill each other. Second lining for y'all. Yeah, they wanted to get in. Well, he was a hot band. They, you see, uh, Sellatex, the Sellatex Corporation, and, uh, I, I don't know whether it was a police band. I don't quite remember. Uh, this Italian fella that had an Italian brisilleri outfit. They were dressed like the brisilleris. Well, that's where the Majotas learned to play, too. But they played strictly march music. And none of the niggers wanted to get around, get around these guys, because there was nothing to it. Just a march. And, uh, they used to call Jack Lane's first band was a Reliance band. Because the niggers would call it the Rillians. Let me get at the Rillians band. They'd all rush in there.
